# Get help with USWDS

For installation, configuration, customization, and usage questions, search or ask in [Discussions Q&A](https://github.com/uswds/uswds/discussions/categories/q-a). Include what you are trying to accomplish, what you tried, and your USWDS version when relevant. If you are unsure whether something is a bug, Q&A is a good place to start.

Use [Issues](https://github.com/uswds/uswds/issues/new/choose) for reproducible bugs, concrete enhancements to existing functionality, and work that needs tracking. A bug report does not need a known root cause or a proposed fix. Accessibility defects belong in Issues too.

Use [Ideas](https://github.com/uswds/uswds/discussions/categories/ideas) for exploratory suggestions and [Proposals](https://github.com/uswds/uswds/discussions/categories/proposals) for new components and patterns. If a discussion identifies implementation work, create an issue and link both conversations.

Report errors in designsystem.digital.gov documentation or website behavior in [uswds-site](https://github.com/uswds/uswds-site/issues/new/choose). Follow the [security policy](https://github.com/uswds/uswds/security/policy) for potential vulnerabilities.

For contribution details, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#choose-the-right-place).
